cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Pick the Prize
cards.instruction: Make them choose which reward, principle, or relationship matters most when not everything can be kept.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You can keep the prize money or fund the team trip. Which matters more?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we do a cheaper trip?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Only if someone adds money. You hold the prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm asking you to choose before everyone else quietly pays for it.

mechanism: Copy tearing a receipt as dividing prize money, then require an explicit choice about sacrificing the trip to keep some winnings.
confusable: Not deliberate budgeting: B2 must identify the torn cheque and A3 pretend the physical mistake was allocation.
comparison: Money/team ambition rather than a couple's competing evening events.
seedUse: Uses prize-versus-team-trip Drive seed; introduces cheque/receipt confusion and replacement to make S04 active.
